upstream_source_licenses: Recorded per repository and file-origin signal; not replaced by the authored-content license.
purpose: A public Go coding capability development candidate inventory before independently verified execution contracts; not a training or protected-final dataset.
count_interpretation: Unique authored request IDs are not independent statistical samples, executed requests, capability labels, task-difficulty labels or natural task-frequency estimates.
limits: The 120 candidates are proposed behavior changes. A gap in the unchanged source has not yet been demonstrated by an independent contract. Already-satisfied, ambiguous or oversized requests must be revised or excluded before execution.
Listed source files are inspected change anchors, not a compiled minimal closure. Support files, target toolchain/platform, dependency versions and independent test scope remain pending.
Each of eight repositories contributes fifteen candidates for initial breadth; this convenience allocation is not a representative task distribution or the protected-final collection plan.
Sources, licenses, file-origin signals and non-truncated trees were read at pinned revisions. Absence of repository NOTICE does not clear dependency, copied-origin or artifact rights.
Code, third-party test bodies, model weights, private repository contents, real user prompts, credentials and raw model traces are not included in this inventory.
All material here has been read during development. It is excluded from protected final; train/selection/calibration/final require separately acquired, group-separated material and an immutable plan.
Repository selection and task decomposition require their own request units, oracles and inventories; these coding candidates are not their labels.
Model labels require whole requested-profile attempts with independent completion checks, process/failure status and complete usage handling. Repetition does not create new distinct requests.

Provisional connected groups are coarse initial constraints, not verified independence. Shared source, forks, origins, solution mechanisms and parent/child/sibling requests can require further group merges.

first_execution_gate: Freeze an unambiguous original behavior request, compatibility policy, toolchain/platform and exact permitted source closure.
Record SHA-256 of the full materialized closure, go.mod/dependency pins, LICENSE/NOTICE and copied-origin notices; Git blob SHA-1 below is only upstream provenance.
Implement an independent verifier that rejects the unchanged baseline, accepts an independently authored correct reference and rejects known incorrect implementations.
Pass baseline compile/meaningful contract checks plus applicable race, hygiene and public-data review before sealing a fresh bounded model-attempt plan.
Do not use baseline/reference/mutant results as actual model outcomes, and do not convert development material into protected final.
readiness_policy.source_support_scope: Per-task files are inspected edit anchors only; package support, platform files, external dependencies and independent tests are not a compiled/frozen closure.
readiness_policy.license_scope: Per-task file signals cover only listed edit anchors. Support files, dependencies, copied origins and eventual source/binary/model/dataset distribution remain pending. Root and origin evidence is stored under repositories[].license.

known_dependency_connection.evidence: Pinned Cobra go.mod requires github.com/spf13/pflag v1.0.9; the pflag HEAD pin is not assumed to be that dependency version.

required_additional_review: All tasks sharing a repository or overlapping source stay connected for repository-generalization splits.
Check fork, copied origin, shared support code and cross-repository solution templates before freezing any split.
Mechanism tags are review aids, not proven independence or difficulty labels; merge related groups when evidence warrants it.
Translations, repeated model attempts and sibling/parent variants remain in their original request group.

existing_catalog.snapshot_scope: Historical seven-candidate catalog at survey time. PDCA53 separately adds taskoutcome-event-key-bounds as the eighth current local candidate; it is not one of these 120 upstream source candidates and has zero model attempts.
existing_catalog.relationship: New upstream anchors differ from the existing laya-tools source. Budget, snapshot, filter and state mechanisms can still be conceptually related; no exhaustive deduplication or independence claim is made.
existing_catalog.action: Preserve all existing frozen requests and records. Review shared mechanisms before any split; do not add these 120 to executed or labeled counts.

recommended_contract_development_batch.interpretation: Order for designing compact independent contracts after feasibility and rights review; not a ranking of measured model difficulty or permission to launch attempts.

tasks.prompt: Add a checked normalization setter that rejects collisions before changing any flag names or lookup tables; preserve the existing setter.

proposed_acceptance_only: Colliding names return an error and retain both original lookups.
A noncolliding normalizer updates formal and changed-flag lookups consistently.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in unknown-token report containing original argv indexes and spellings, without changing existing ignore or pass-through behavior.

proposed_acceptance_only: Mixed long and shorthand inputs yield exact original indexes.
Recognized flag values and tokens after -- are not mislabeled unknown.

tasks.prompt: Add a per-flag single-assignment annotation that rejects the second parsed assignment, including shorthand aliases, while leaving ordinary flags unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: The repeated assignment returns an error without replacing the first value.
Long and shorthand names identify the same assignment; unannotated repeats remain valid.

tasks.prompt: Add a sentinel allowing ParseAll callbacks to stop successfully and expose untouched remaining arguments without invoking further callbacks.

proposed_acceptance_only: A stop preserves all unvisited tokens in order.
Ordinary callback errors still fail; normal parsing remains unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in rune-count display-width mode for wrapped flag help, with a specified one-column-per-rune contract and unchanged byte-based default.

proposed_acceptance_only: Multibyte flag names align under the chosen rune contract.
Narrow widths terminate and preserve words; default ASCII output matches baseline.

tasks.prompt: Honor a sensitive-default annotation in help rendering by showing a fixed redaction marker while retaining the actual parsed default value.

proposed_acceptance_only: Neither the default literal nor its quoted form appears in help.
Parsing, Get values, and unannotated help defaults are unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Copy annotation slices when they are registered and add a getter returning an owned copy, preventing caller mutation of stored metadata.

proposed_acceptance_only: Mutating registration inputs or getter results cannot alter stored annotations.
Replacing an annotation and unknown-flag errors have explicit behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add a bounded count value that rejects increment or explicit assignments outside its declared range without overflow or changing the previous value.

proposed_acceptance_only: At-limit increments and oversized integer text fail without mutation.
Ordinary Count behavior is preserved; valid explicit values and grouped shorthand increments work.

tasks.prompt: Add a bounded string-slice flag whose limit applies to the accumulated parsed entries and to Append/Replace, with atomic refusal on overflow.

proposed_acceptance_only: Quoted commas count as one entry; repeated flags enforce the cumulative limit.
Failed Set, Append, and Replace leave prior entries intact; unlimited behavior is unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Add a snapshot getter for string-to-string flags that returns an independent map while preserving the existing documented shared-map getter.

proposed_acceptance_only: Changing the snapshot does not alter later Get or parsed values.
Nil, empty, and populated maps retain their distinct contracts.

tasks.prompt: Add deferred function flags whose callbacks run in argv order only after argument parsing succeeds; existing immediate Func flags stay unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: Invalid later syntax prevents all deferred callbacks.
Successful parses invoke each registered occurrence once in input order and propagate callback failure.

tasks.prompt: Add a checked copy-to-Go-FlagSet API that reports destination name conflicts before copying any flags and preserves both source and destination on refusal.

proposed_acceptance_only: An existing destination name yields deterministic conflict details without partial copies.
Disjoint flags retain values, boolean optional-argument behavior, and source ownership.

tasks.prompt: Add a Text value error wrapper that preserves errors.Is/As causes and identifies the flag name without embedding the supplied value.

proposed_acceptance_only: A sentinel unmarshal failure remains discoverable with errors.Is.
Error text includes the flag identity but excludes a synthetic sensitive value.

tasks.prompt: Add a time-flag constructor accepting a location for zone-less layouts; explicitly zoned input retains its zone and existing constructors keep their behavior.

proposed_acceptance_only: The same zone-less date resolves in the supplied fixed location.
Explicit offsets and invalid input have specified nonmutating behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in canonical-network flag value that rejects CIDRs with host bits set, while preserving the existing masking IPNet value.

proposed_acceptance_only: Canonical IPv4/IPv6 networks pass and host-address CIDRs fail without mutation.
Default IPNet masking behavior and invalid-prefix errors remain unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Validate IOFS.Sub using fs.ValidPath before constructing a sub-filesystem, returning a PathError for invalid names and preserving the valid root case.

proposed_acceptance_only: Empty, parent, and absolute paths fail before touching the underlying filesystem.
Valid directories and . expose the expected subtree with fs-compatible errors.

tasks.title_ko: 안전 쓰기의 원자적 새 파일 생성
tasks.prompt: Make SafeWriteReader acquire its destination with exclusive creation instead of an existence check followed by truncating Create.

proposed_acceptance_only: A controlled competing creator cannot have its contents overwritten.
Copy and close errors remain observable; a newly created valid destination contains the input.

tasks.title_ko: 실패 시 원본을 지키는 파일 교체
tasks.prompt: Add an atomic replacement helper using a sibling temporary file and Rename, preserving the old destination on copy or close failure and removing temporary residue.

proposed_acceptance_only: Injected copy and close failures leave prior bytes intact.
Successful replacement preserves declared mode and leaves no temporary files.

tasks.prompt: Add ReadFileLimit with a documented maximum byte count, distinguishing an oversized file from read failure without returning a silently truncated success.

proposed_acceptance_only: Exact-limit files pass and limit-plus-one files return a typed size error.
Unknown Stat sizes and injected reader errors are handled without unbounded allocation.

tasks.prompt: Define and implement cursor advancement for mixed positive-count and read-all UnionFile directory calls, with stable layer precedence and no duplicate entries.

proposed_acceptance_only: Paged reads followed by read-all consume each merged entry once.
Repeated EOF and duplicate names across layers obey the declared order and precedence.

tasks.prompt: Preserve source permission bits when copy-on-write materializes a base file, and propagate metadata-setting failure instead of reporting complete success.

proposed_acceptance_only: A source mode survives materialization without widening permissions.
Injected Chmod or Chtimes errors are visible and the cleanup contract is explicit.

tasks.prompt: Add an explicit per-path invalidation API for CacheOnReadFs that forces the next read to refresh while leaving unrelated paths cached.

proposed_acceptance_only: A changed base file becomes visible after invalidation.
Unrelated cached files avoid base reads; a missing base and layer-owned files have explicit outcomes.

tasks.prompt: Add a constructor accepting a clock for cache expiry so tests and callers can control time without package-global replacement; preserve the existing constructor.

proposed_acceptance_only: Before, exactly at, and after expiry follow a specified boundary contract.
Two filesystem instances use independent clocks without global races.

tasks.prompt: Add opt-in tombstone deletion for base-only files in CopyOnWriteFs, hiding deleted entries from later reads and merged directory listings without changing the base.

proposed_acceptance_only: Delete, reopen, and enumerate agree on hidden state.
Recreating the layer path clears its tombstone; default unsupported deletion behavior is preserved.

tasks.title_ko: 읽기 전용 열기 플래그의 금지 범위
tasks.prompt: Reject mutation-capable OpenFile flags in ReadOnlyFs even when the access mode is read-only, including create and truncate, before calling the source.

proposed_acceptance_only: A spy source sees no call for O_RDONLY|O_TRUNC or O_CREATE.
Ordinary read-only opens and existing permission errors remain usable.

tasks.prompt: Require both source and destination file names to satisfy RegexpFs during Rename while preserving directory operations and avoiding mutation on refusal.

proposed_acceptance_only: A matching source cannot be moved to a blocked file name.
Allowed renames and directory traversal retain documented behavior.

tasks.prompt: Implement a declared memory-file Seek contract that rejects invalid whence and negative positions without moving the current offset.

proposed_acceptance_only: Invalid seeks leave the next read at the prior position.
Valid seeks beyond EOF followed by write produce the specified zero-filled gap.

tasks.prompt: Reject moving a MemMapFs directory into its own descendant before altering parent registrations, and preserve the entire original subtree on failure.

proposed_acceptance_only: Controlled self-descendant moves leave all paths and directory memberships unchanged.
A valid subtree move preserves descendant contents and modes.

tasks.prompt: Add a bounded Glob API that reports limit overflow distinctly rather than returning an apparently complete partial match list; keep ordinary Glob unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: Exact-boundary and overflow cases are deterministic and sorted.
Invalid patterns remain syntax errors; no-match differs from overflow.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in no-symlink traversal policy to BasePathFs using supported link inspection; unsupported link inspection must return an explicit unsupported result.

proposed_acceptance_only: A symlink into a sibling is refused before opening its target.
Ordinary lexical paths still work; lexical checks alone are not presented as symlink confinement.

tasks.prompt: Add CheckedAddCommand that rejects ancestor cycles and already-parented commands before mutation, leaving legacy AddCommand unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: A cycle or foreign parent is rejected with both trees unchanged.
A valid insertion sets one parent and updates command ordering.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in sibling namespace validation that detects name/alias collisions before insertion and reports all conflicting identifiers deterministically.

proposed_acceptance_only: A new alias colliding with a sibling name cannot redirect resolution.
Exact nonconflicting names and legacy prefix behavior remain supported.

tasks.prompt: Add a suggestion API returning distinct command names ranked by edit distance and name, with a maximum count and excluded unavailable commands.

proposed_acceptance_only: Duplicate SuggestFor hits produce one candidate and ties have stable ordering.
Zero and positive limits behave explicitly; disabled commands never appear.

tasks.prompt: Make flag-group completion apply temporary required/hidden annotations without leaving changed flag metadata after the completion request.

proposed_acceptance_only: Completing one exclusive flag does not hide siblings in a later unrelated request.
Normal execution and preexisting annotations match the pre-completion state.

tasks.prompt: Add opt-in context preflight cancellation before initializer and run hooks, preserving help behavior and the existing execution default.

proposed_acceptance_only: A pre-canceled context causes no initializer, pre-run, or run side effects.
Uncanceled commands execute normally; help treatment is specified separately.

tasks.prompt: Add error-returning diagnostic write methods that propagate writer failures without process exit or silently reporting a complete write.

proposed_acceptance_only: A short writer and a failing writer produce distinguishable returned errors.
Successful output uses the inherited error writer and exact requested bytes.

tasks.prompt: Add MatchAllErrors that runs each positional validator once and joins its errors, while preserving short-circuit MatchAll.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two independent failures remain discoverable through errors.Is/As.
All-success returns nil and validation order is deterministic.

tasks.prompt: Handle empty or malformed required-flag annotations with a declared validation error instead of indexing unchecked data, preserving valid annotations.

proposed_acceptance_only: Nil, empty, and invalid boolean annotations do not panic.
Valid required flags retain their missing and supplied behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add command-local finalizers with a declared once-per-execution cleanup contract, including run failure, without replacing process-global finalizers.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two command trees do not run each other's local cleanup.
Run success and run error each execute the selected finalizers once.

tasks.prompt: Add a checked group-registration API that refuses duplicate group IDs atomically and preserves existing children and group order.

proposed_acceptance_only: Duplicate IDs return deterministic errors without partial registration.
Unique groups render in insertion order and existing AddGroup remains available.

tasks.prompt: Respect an opt-in completion context cancellation check before user completion callbacks, returning an error directive without invoking them.

proposed_acceptance_only: A canceled request never invokes a spy completion callback.
Uncanceled candidates and directives remain identical to baseline.

tasks.prompt: Add a safe ActiveHelp helper that normalizes embedded newline and tab characters into a single displayed message without creating fake completion records.

proposed_acceptance_only: Untrusted multiline input produces one ActiveHelp entry.
Ordinary single-line messages keep their content and completion-array order.

tasks.prompt: Add a checked Markdown-tree generator that detects colliding normalized filenames before writing any output files.

proposed_acceptance_only: Command paths that map to one filename fail without partial output.
Noncolliding trees preserve links and file content under the chosen mapping.

tasks.prompt: Add an explicit generation-date option for man-tree output without reading the wall clock when it is supplied, preserving current defaults.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two runs with the same supplied date produce byte-identical headers.
Unset dates retain default behavior and timezone formatting is specified.

tasks.prompt: Add opt-in alias and group-ID fields to YAML command documentation with stable alias ordering and no empty fields when the option is disabled.

proposed_acceptance_only: Enabled output includes declared aliases and group ID once.
Disabled output matches the existing schema, including inherited options.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in retry policy that permits safe methods or a declared idempotency key and declines unsafe body-changing requests without that key.

proposed_acceptance_only: A scripted transport distinguishes GET, POST without a key, and keyed POST.
DefaultRetryPolicy remains unchanged and transport failures preserve their causes.

tasks.prompt: Add a bounded server-delay backoff that caps valid Retry-After values at the caller's maximum while preserving the original DefaultBackoff API.

proposed_acceptance_only: Numeric and dated Retry-After values respect the same explicit cap.
Missing or invalid headers use the declared exponential fallback.

tasks.prompt: Reject Retry-After seconds that cannot be represented as time.Duration before multiplication, returning the existing invalid-header result.

proposed_acceptance_only: The largest representable boundary and one larger value are distinguished.
Negative and malformed values remain invalid rather than producing wrapped waits.

tasks.prompt: Add a policy for selecting the first valid Retry-After value from multiple header entries, with a defined fallback when all entries are invalid.

proposed_acceptance_only: An invalid first entry followed by a valid entry yields its delay.
The policy documents order and keeps the existing first-entry parser available.

tasks.prompt: Add opt-in refusal of a retry whose backoff cannot finish before the request deadline, returning the deadline cause without starting another transport attempt.

proposed_acceptance_only: A controlled clock verifies no retry starts when the budget is insufficient.
A retry that fits the remaining deadline still runs; no real sleeping is required by the proposed contract.

tasks.prompt: Add a typed exhaustion error exposing attempts and final status while preserving wrapped error causes and the legacy message compatibility contract.

proposed_acceptance_only: errors.As retrieves exact attempts and status after scripted failures.
errors.Is still finds the final cause, and successful responses do not produce exhaustion errors.

tasks.prompt: Add a request constructor that snapshots byte-slice bodies so caller mutation cannot alter later retry payloads, preserving the existing constructor.

proposed_acceptance_only: Caller mutation after construction changes neither first nor replayed bytes.
Nil and zero-length bodies retain declared content-length behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add a bounded body-buffering setter that refuses readers exceeding the limit without replacing the previous replayable body.

proposed_acceptance_only: Exact-limit readers succeed and overflow returns a typed budget error.
Read failures preserve the original body and do not expose partial success.

tasks.title_ko: 재시도 준비 실패 시 본문 정리
tasks.prompt: Define and enforce cleanup when PrepareRetry fails: close owned bodies exactly once, stop further transport attempts, and retain the preparation error.

proposed_acceptance_only: Spy bodies record the declared close count without leaks.
A preparation sentinel remains discoverable and no subsequent transport call occurs.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional response hook receiving the attempt ordinal and retry decision, including final non-retry responses, without changing the existing hook signature.

proposed_acceptance_only: Scripted success-after-retry yields ordered ordinals and one hook per observed response.
Transport errors without a response follow an explicit hook contract.

tasks.prompt: Add configurable query-key redaction for log URL projection while retaining non-sensitive query entries and leaving the actual request URL untouched.

proposed_acceptance_only: Synthetic token/password query values do not appear in either logger format.
The transport sees the original URL and the configured redaction-key slice is copied.

tasks.prompt: Add a backoff constructor with an injected clock for HTTP-date headers, without modifying package-global time or another client's behavior.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two backoff instances evaluate the same date against separate clocks.
Past dates return the specified zero wait and numeric delays are clock-independent.

tasks.prompt: Add a jitter-backoff constructor accepting a caller-owned random source with a declared range, leaving the existing helper unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: A deterministic source yields reproducible in-range delays across attempts.
Invalid min/max and arithmetic overflow have explicit outcomes rather than wrapped durations.

tasks.prompt: Add an explicit constructor for RoundTripper that captures a supplied client and rejects nil rather than silently substituting a default client.

proposed_acceptance_only: A spy supplied client handles every request and nil construction fails.
The legacy zero-value adapter remains usable under its existing contract.

tasks.prompt: Recognize wrapped TLS certificate verification errors through errors.As in the certificate-error helper, avoiding retries of a typed permanent certificate failure.

proposed_acceptance_only: Direct and multiply wrapped certificate failures are classified alike.
A recoverable transport error is not incorrectly treated as a certificate failure.

tasks.prompt: Return a declared error for nil DecoderConfig and nil Result pointers in NewDecoder without reflection panics or partial metadata initialization.

proposed_acceptance_only: Nil config and typed-nil result fail without panic.
Valid addressable result pointers retain existing setup behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional maximum decode depth with path-aware errors, preserving unlimited behavior when zero and rejecting invalid negative configuration.

proposed_acceptance_only: Nested maps and pointers obey one declared depth convention.
Exceeded depth identifies the path; zero retains current decoding behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add opt-in ancestor-cycle detection for pointer/map inputs, allowing shared acyclic subobjects and returning a path-aware cycle error.

proposed_acceptance_only: A self-reference terminates with a cycle error.
A shared node reached along separate acyclic branches is not rejected.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional maximum total decoded container entries, counting nested maps and slices before allocating oversized destination containers.

proposed_acceptance_only: Nested entries share the total budget rather than resetting per container.
Exact-boundary inputs succeed and budget refusal reports a path and no claimed complete result.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in ambiguity error when multiple input keys match one destination field through MatchName; do not resolve the conflict by random map order.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two case-folded or caller-normalized keys produce deterministic ambiguity details.
An exact unique key and default compatibility mode retain current behavior.

tasks.prompt: Add stable ordering for reported Unused and Unset metadata and aggregated strict-key diagnostics, without changing which keys are considered used.

proposed_acceptance_only: Maps inserted in different orders yield identical ordered metadata.
Nested paths and valid decoding results preserve their identities.

tasks.prompt: Add an opt-in transactional decode mode for a documented supported set of scalar, slice, map, and struct outputs, committing only after decoding succeeds.

proposed_acceptance_only: An invalid later field leaves the original destination unchanged.
Unsupported aliasing/custom-hook shapes return an explicit unsupported error; ordinary mode is preserved.

tasks.prompt: Preserve all failed alternative-hook causes with errors.Join while keeping first-success short-circuit behavior and a declared empty-hook result.

proposed_acceptance_only: errors.Is can find sentinels from two failed hooks.
A successful earlier hook prevents later invocation and returns its value unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Specify and implement propagation of typed-nil pointer results between composed hooks so later hooks can inspect the nil type without reflection panic.

proposed_acceptance_only: A typed-nil result reaches the next hook with its declared type.
Untyped nil and ordinary transformed values remain distinct.

tasks.prompt: Add an escaped-delimiter string-to-slice hook with explicit empty-field and trailing-escape rules, leaving the simple split hook unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: Escaped delimiters and backslashes round-trip under the declared grammar.
Invalid trailing escapes fail; non-string inputs pass through untouched.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional lossless-numeric conversion mode that rejects fractional-to-integer and out-of-range conversions instead of silently truncating or wrapping.

proposed_acceptance_only: Fractional, unsigned-negative, and boundary overflow inputs fail with field paths.
Exactly representable values succeed and legacy weak conversion stays unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Add a time hook using a supplied location for zone-less layouts, while preserving explicitly zoned input and the existing constructor.

proposed_acceptance_only: Zone-less values use the supplied fixed zone.
Explicit offsets are preserved and parse errors retain their cause.

tasks.prompt: Reject multiple remain-tagged fields within one effective squashed struct before assigning unmatched data, with a deterministic schema error.

proposed_acceptance_only: Direct and embedded remain conflicts are reported consistently.
A single remain field still receives exactly the unmatched entries.

tasks.prompt: Add an explicit tag-precedence option distinguishing a missing tag from an explicitly empty tag when multiple tag names are configured.

proposed_acceptance_only: Missing and explicitly empty first tags choose the documented fallback differently.
The default first-nonempty behavior is preserved and skip tags remain honored.

tasks.prompt: Add a text-unmarshal hook variant that supports named string types and pointer targets while constructing a fresh destination value and preserving typed causes.

proposed_acceptance_only: Named strings and pointer/value targets produce correct independent values.
A mutating failing unmarshaler cannot corrupt a preexisting output value.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional total input-byte limit across all INI sources, returning a distinct limit error instead of accepting a silently truncated configuration.

proposed_acceptance_only: Multiple readers share the limit and exact-boundary data succeeds.
Oversized and short/erroring readers have distinct outcomes.

tasks.prompt: Add a strict quoted-value mode where comment markers inside quotes are literal and trailing comments begin only after the closing quote.

proposed_acceptance_only: Quoted URLs and semicolons survive while outside comments are removed.
Unclosed quotes are explicit parse errors and default options remain compatible.

tasks.prompt: Add a duplicate-section policy with merge, preserve, and reject modes, defining interaction with case-insensitive names and existing nonunique sections.

proposed_acceptance_only: Each policy gives a distinct controlled result for repeated normalized names.
The default retains compatibility and rejection reports the offending source position.

tasks.prompt: Add a strict interpolation API that detects cycles across keys and returns the cycle path rather than recursively invoking String without a finite contract.

proposed_acceptance_only: Self and cross-section cycles terminate with explicit paths.
An acyclic chain and escaped literal percent content resolve under the declared rules.

tasks.title_ko: 중복 키 값의 빈 값 보존
tasks.prompt: Add a shadow-value snapshot API that preserves explicit empty assignments and returns owned data without changing ValueWithShadows compatibility.

proposed_acceptance_only: An empty assignment remains distinguishable from an absent assignment.
Caller mutation of the returned slice cannot alter shadow values or their order.

tasks.prompt: Declare and enforce a reload policy for one-shot io.Reader sources: either bounded snapshot reuse or an explicit non-reloadable error instead of silent empty reload.

proposed_acceptance_only: A repeated reload cannot silently lose the original reader configuration.
File-backed sources still reload normally and the chosen snapshot has a documented bound.

tasks.prompt: Make checked Append validate every new source before changing the retained source list, and preserve the prior configuration on invalid-source refusal.

proposed_acceptance_only: A valid source followed by an unsupported source type causes no partial registration.
A subsequent Reload uses only the original list after refusal.

tasks.prompt: Return a declared range error for negative or missing section indexes without changing section lists, while preserving valid duplicate-index deletion.

proposed_acceptance_only: Out-of-range deletion leaves names, indexes, and contents unchanged.
Deleting a middle repeated section reindexes only later instances.

tasks.prompt: Add a checked RenameKey operation preserving order, value, shadows, and comments, rejecting normalized destination collisions atomically.

proposed_acceptance_only: Successful rename updates every lookup/index and retains the original ordinal.
Case-normalized collisions leave both keys and their metadata unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Add an effective-parent-key view that removes shadowed ancestor names using nearest-parent precedence, while leaving the existing raw ParentKeys list intact.

proposed_acceptance_only: Three nested sections choose the nearest ancestor for repeated keys.
Ordering and insensitive-name handling are deterministic without mutating parents.

tasks.prompt: Add atomic save through a sibling temporary file and replacement, leaving the prior destination intact on encode/write/close failure.

proposed_acceptance_only: Injected output and close failures preserve previous destination bytes.
Successful save removes temporary residue and applies the declared permissions policy.

tasks.prompt: Add per-file write-style options overriding global PrettyFormat/LineBreak values so independent files can render concurrently without global mutation.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two files produce different declared styles under controlled concurrent rendering.
Unset instance options preserve existing output defaults.

tasks.prompt: Add a required struct-tag option for StrictMapTo that distinguishes a missing key from a present empty value and reports the exact field.

proposed_acceptance_only: Missing required keys fail while explicitly empty strings count as present.
Optional fields and ordinary MapTo retain their current behavior.

tasks.prompt: Return typed validation errors for nil interfaces and typed-nil struct pointers in mapping/reflection APIs instead of reflection panics.

proposed_acceptance_only: Every specified nil input form terminates without panic.
Valid structs and supported struct slices continue to map as before.

tasks.prompt: Add indexed aggregate errors for strict list conversion so callers can inspect all invalid element positions and underlying parse causes without partial-success claims.

proposed_acceptance_only: Two invalid elements retain both indexes and errors.Is/As causes.
Valid lists preserve element order and legacy first-error APIs remain available.

tasks.prompt: Make ParseBytes evaluate fractional decimal sizes with exact arithmetic, checking the uint64 range before truncating toward zero.

proposed_acceptance_only: MaxUint64 followed by .0 B is accepted exactly, while an exact value above the range is rejected before truncation.
Small fractional values and SI/IEC factors agree with an independently specified rational oracle; existing integer grammar is preserved.

tasks.prompt: Add ParseByteRate returning an exact rational number of bytes per second for decimal sizes followed by /s, /min, or /h.

proposed_acceptance_only: 1 KiB/min yields 256/15 bytes per second and 1.5 MB/h yields 1250/3 without integer truncation.
Specify whitespace and case rules; invalid time units and negative inputs are rejected.

tasks.prompt: Add FormatBytesInUnit for a caller-selected SI or IEC unit and zero to six decimal places, with no automatic unit selection.

proposed_acceptance_only: 1536 with KiB and one decimal place produces 1.5 KiB; define rounding before implementation.
Zero, MaxUint64, rounding boundaries and invalid units or precision are checked with a rational oracle.

tasks.prompt: Add BigBytesN for non-negative big.Int counts, preserving requested significant digits without converting the whole count to float64 or mutating the input.

proposed_acceptance_only: Values above 2^53, unit-promotion boundaries and 10^50 retain precision and leave the input unchanged.
Specify precision bounds, maximum-unit behavior and promotion after rounding; nil and negative inputs fail explicitly.

tasks.prompt: Add ParseCommaStrict accepting ungrouped integers or canonical three-digit comma groups and rejecting malformed grouping.

proposed_acceptance_only: Canonical output round-trips across the int64 range, including negatives.
Malformed grouping, overflow, whitespace, fractions and the specified leading-zero/sign cases fail; simply stripping commas must not pass.

tasks.prompt: Add AppendComma that appends a grouped int64 to a caller-owned byte buffer, with no additional allocation when capacity is sufficient.

proposed_acceptance_only: The caller prefix, zero, signs and full int64 boundaries are preserved with either sufficient or insufficient capacity.
An independently configured allocation measurement detects temporary-string implementations; the measurement toolchain and conditions must be frozen.

tasks.prompt: Add an int64 template formatter preserving every digit above 2^53 while supporting signs, Unicode separators and fractional zero padding.

proposed_acceptance_only: MinInt64, MaxInt64 and adjacent values around 2^53 retain all digits; malformed templates return errors.
Freeze the template grammar, retain the source attribution and separately record the pinned gorhill gist license; do not reuse FormatFloat as the sole oracle.

tasks.prompt: Add FtoaPrecise with zero to eighteen decimal places, rounding the original float64 value and removing trailing zeros.

proposed_acceptance_only: Precision beyond six digits and rounding that carries into the integer part are covered without an intermediate six-digit truncation.
Freeze tie rounding, negative zero, subnormal, NaN and infinity behavior; out-of-range precision returns an error.

tasks.prompt: Extend ParseSI to accept signed scientific-notation magnitudes without confusing an exponent marker with an exa prefix.

proposed_acceptance_only: +1.25e3 kW yields 1.25e6 W while 1 EW yields 1e18 W; existing micro aliases and unit strings remain supported.
Freeze exponent/prefix precedence and whitespace; incomplete exponents and out-of-range numeric values fail.

tasks.prompt: Add a rounded SI formatter that promotes the prefix when rounding would otherwise display 1000 of the current unit.

proposed_acceptance_only: 999960 W at one decimal place produces 1 MW with defined rounding; negative, tiny, zero and largest-prefix cases are checked.
Freeze precision limits and the clamp rule above Q, and reject implementations that merely reuse truncating display.

tasks.prompt: Add CustomRelTimeChecked that validates magnitude tables and format directives before formatting and returns errors instead of panicking.

proposed_acceptance_only: Empty or unordered tables, non-positive divisors and unsupported verbs fail before formatting; input tables remain unchanged.
Freeze the allowed %d, %s and %% grammar, and check exact time boundaries with independent malformed-table cases.

tasks.prompt: Add DurationParts formatting a duration as one to eight nonzero parts from weeks down to nanoseconds, with a single leading sign.

proposed_acceptance_only: A two-part limit displays 1h 2m for 1h 2m 3s; zero displays 0s and negative values use one sign.
Freeze truncation and unit spelling and check the full duration range, especially MinInt64 absolute-value overflow.

tasks.prompt: Add Ordinal64 choosing the English suffix from the magnitude while preserving the sign across the full int64 range.

proposed_acceptance_only: Negative and positive 1, 2, 3, 11, 12 and 13 have specified suffixes, and full-range integer digits are preserved.
Declare this signed-ordinal behavior as a project contract and preserve the existing int API.

tasks.prompt: Add ASCII case-preserving pluralization for lowercase, title case and uppercase words, while retaining explicit plural overrides.

proposed_acceptance_only: INDEX, Matrix and Lady produce the specified uppercase/title-case plurals; quantity one returns the input and explicit overrides remain unchanged.
Freeze empty and mixed-case behavior; do not claim support for all English morphology or Unicode casing.

tasks.prompt: Add quoted word-series formatting with JSON string escaping and an optional Oxford comma.

proposed_acceptance_only: Zero through three items and the Oxford option follow a frozen conjunction and spacing contract.
Commas, quotes, backslashes, newlines and Unicode are escaped per item, and the input slice is not changed.

tasks.prompt: Add ParseCanonical accepting only the lowercase 36-character hyphenated form and rejecting alternate encodings.

proposed_acceptance_only: Canonical Nil, Max and ordinary identifiers succeed; uppercase, URN, raw hex, braces, whitespace and malformed hyphens fail with a Nil result.
Declare a project canonical-text policy and preserve the broad input compatibility of existing Parse.

tasks.prompt: Add ParseUUIDs preserving order and duplicates, returning no partial result and an indexed wrapped error if any item is invalid.

proposed_acceptance_only: Supported representations retain order and duplicates; a middle failure returns nil with the correct index and discoverable cause.
Freeze empty-result and indexed-error contracts; partial-success implementations must fail verification.

tasks.prompt: Add UUID.AppendText preserving a caller-buffer prefix and requiring no additional allocation when capacity is sufficient.

proposed_acceptance_only: The canonical 36-character lowercase representation is appended correctly for Nil, Max and ordinary UUIDs under both capacity conditions.
Freeze the signature and toolchain interface contract; verify allocation behavior independently.

tasks.prompt: Add UUIDs.SortedUnique returning a new lexicographically sorted slice with duplicates removed and the input unchanged.

proposed_acceptance_only: Independent fixed byte vectors check unsigned-byte ordering, Nil, Max, duplicate removal and empty inputs.
The original order and backing storage remain unchanged, and result mutation cannot affect the input; freeze nil-versus-empty policy.

tasks.prompt: Add NewRandomBatchFromReader producing zero to 4096 version-4 UUIDs atomically from a supplied reader.

proposed_acceptance_only: Version, variant and remaining entropy bits are correct for split reads; a middle EOF returns no partial result.
Invalid counts fail before reading, and zero performs no read; do not claim entropy consumption can be rolled back.

tasks.prompt: Add UUID.WriteTextTo reporting bytes written and propagating short writes or writer errors without accepting truncated output.

proposed_acceptance_only: A complete write emits 36 canonical characters, a short write without error returns io.ErrShortWrite, and an error preserves count and cause.
Freeze a single-write or bounded-retry policy, and use independent full, short, zero and error writers.

tasks.prompt: Make UUID.Scan reset its receiver on nil or empty input while preserving the old value on invalid input and wrapping parse errors.

proposed_acceptance_only: A prefilled receiver becomes Nil for nil, empty string and empty bytes; invalid and unsupported inputs leave the receiver unchanged.
Declare the compatibility change explicitly and retain discoverable parse causes.

tasks.prompt: Add ValueBinary for SQL callers needing an owned sixteen-byte driver value instead of textual UUID storage.

proposed_acceptance_only: The returned driver.Value is a sixteen-byte slice preserving every byte, including Nil, and mutation cannot affect the UUID.
Freeze the new signature and retain existing textual Value; make no claims about support by a particular database driver.

tasks.prompt: Let NullUUID.UnmarshalBinary accept an empty slice as null while treating sixteen zero bytes as a valid Nil UUID.

proposed_acceptance_only: Empty input clears both fields, sixteen zero bytes yields Valid=true, and MarshalBinary round-trips the distinction.
Any other input length fails without changing either existing field.

tasks.prompt: Add checked hash-based UUID creation rejecting short hashes or invalid version numbers and propagating failed or short writes.

proposed_acceptance_only: Fixed independent vectors agree for standard MD5/SHA1; short hash sizes and Sum results are rejected without an identifier.
Freeze supported versions, nil/typed-nil and hash-state behavior; custom hash writers expose preserved failures and short writes.

tasks.prompt: Add reversible conversion between RFC-variant version-1 and version-6 layouts, preserving timestamp, clock sequence and node bytes.

proposed_acceptance_only: Independent byte vectors verify field rearrangement and the round trip across timestamp boundaries while preserving other fields.
Wrong versions and variants fail; freeze failure results and do not use production Time extraction as the sole oracle.

tasks.prompt: Add Timestamp returning a UTC time for version 1, 6 or 7 UUIDs and an error for unsupported versions or variants.

proposed_acceptance_only: Fixed bit-layout vectors check Gregorian 100ns timestamps and Unix millisecond timestamps, including the maximum v7 48-bit time.
Unsupported versions and variants fail; large times must not rely on an overflowing UnixNano comparison.

tasks.title_ko: 전역 상태 없는 명시적 UUID v7
tasks.prompt: Add NewV7At using an explicit time and reader, preserving random rand_a and rand_b bits without changing global generator state.

proposed_acceptance_only: Fixed time and reader yield exact timestamp, version, variant and entropy fields, with deterministic output.
Pre-epoch and above-range times fail before reading; freeze millisecond truncation and do not require global monotonicity of this pure API.

tasks.title_ko: 독립적인 단조 증가 UUID v7 생성기
tasks.prompt: Add an instance-owned V7 generator with injected clock and reader, concurrency safety, monotonic ordering and no state advance after failed entropy reads.

proposed_acceptance_only: Serial results increase at equal or backward times; fixed counter-carry, maximum-time and entropy-failure recovery cases pass.
Separate instances keep independent state and concurrency is race-checked; freeze lock and injected-callback contracts without claiming uniqueness across all instances.

tasks.prompt: Add NewDCESecurityChecked rejecting domains outside Person, Group and Org before consuming entropy or changing generator state.

proposed_acceptance_only: Allowed domains produce the specified v2 markers and ID bytes under synthetic clock, node and reader fixtures.
Invalid domains return Nil plus an error with no reader or generator-state effects; isolate global-state tests and never record actual UID, GID or MAC addresses.
